decision.reason: One-minute closed bars provide five times as many decision opportunities; 1.5 sigma and 1.2 volume are a modest preregistered activity hypothesis, not optimized against past returns. All admission economics and risk remain frozen.
decision.counterargument: Shorter moves may never clear the unchanged two-times-full-cost gate. More signals can increase costs and information-driven losses. Thirty round trips may be infeasible within bounded losses.
decision.evaluation: New forward window only, 48h from parent activation; target 30 complete flat-to-flat episodes, no forced trades. Insufficient samples means unproven. Stop on existing loss limits or integrity faults.
